a7q1.note: The Master of a Million Faces

resistPenalties.text: Your resistances are now 30% lower (Kitava's affliction). Check that your elemental resistances are still capped.
Your resistances are now 60% lower in total. Cap them before mapping.

notes.text: Sockets are white by default and accept any gem. Matching a gem's colour to a coloured socket gives a bonus. Any linked item is usable: don't skip links because of colours.
Mercenaries of Trarthus are in the core game. They are temporary and leave after some areas unless you play the Luminary (Scion) ascendancy.
5-link chance: clear the league encounter in this zone. In 3.27 and 3.29 it dropped a 5-link body armour once (not in 3.28). If nothing drops, re-running the zone can help.
Second 5-link chance: clear the league encounter in this zone (dropped a 5-link body armour once in 3.27 and 3.29).

Link plan: Tabula Rasa (6-link, level 3) as soon as you can trade; bench a 4-link after Kaom's Stronghold (Act 4, 5 fusings); the league encounters in The Slave Pens (Act 5) and Act 6 Twilight Strand have dropped a 5-link body armour; otherwise fuse a 5-6 socket armour (~150 fusings).

reminders.text: Movement speed boots: any normal boots + Quicksilver Flask + Orb of Augmentation at a vendor = 10% movement speed.
Level 12: put your movement speed boots back in with another Quicksilver + Augmentation for 15%.
Level 24: boots + Quicksilver + Augmentation again for 20% movement speed.
Level 32: 25% movement speed boots are possible now (same recipe).
Level 44: 30% movement speed boots are possible now (same recipe).
Weapon upgrade: your weapon + a magic Rustic Sash + Blacksmith's Whetstone = 40-49% increased Physical Damage. Spell weapons: Chain Belt instead of the sash.
Weapon upgrade: a rare Rustic Sash in the recipe gives 50-69% increased Physical Damage.
3.29: every class can buy Faster Attacks Support from Nessa now.
3.29: every class can buy Faster Casting Support from Yeena now.
Kaom's Stronghold unlocked the bench 4-link: craft it on your body armour for 5 Orbs of Fusing.
Be level 32 before Kaom's Stronghold: the fights there are much harder below it.
Lunaris side of Act 8 freezes a lot: a life flask with the 'of Heat' suffix (freeze immunity) helps.
The Belly of the Beast (Act 9) makes you bleed: bring a flask with the 'of Staunching' suffix.
Act 5 ends with Kitava: afterwards your resistances drop by 30%. Gear up resistances before the fight.
Act 10 Kitava drops your resistances by another 30% (-60% total). Cap them for maps.

normal.text: Normal Labyrinth (area level 33): do it after Act 3 for your first 2 ascendancy points.

cruel.text: Cruel Labyrinth (area level 55): do it after Act 7.

merciless.text: Merciless Labyrinth (area level 68): do it after Act 10.

items: Talk to Kirac on Karui Shores: he gives you a map device for your hideout.
Run Merciless Labyrinth (area level 68) if you haven't.
Cap your elemental resistances: you are at -60% now.
Set your pantheon gods (talk to Sin) and upgrade them with a Divine Vessel later.
Switch your loot filter to a stricter level once mapping (NeverSink switches to endgame rules at item level 68 by itself).
Start your atlas passive tree: complete each new map for bonus objectives.
